This cloth is woven from
an astral fabric that glows faintly.

construction of Chateau d'Oraguille.

The Goblins make these cubes out of
fat harvested from sheep wool.
It is a main ingredient in Goblin soap.

532.name: Magicmart Flyer

A flyer for Regine's Magicmart.
It advertises deep price cuts.

533.name: Derfland Humus
desc:
This humus is only found in Derfland.
Its richness is said to come from
crawler droppings in the mix.

desc:
This grass is similar to gysahl greens.
Gausebit wildgrass has medicinal
properties for chocobos, but doesn't
taste very good.

535.name: Engraved Key
desc:
This brass key is engraved with the
San d'Orian royal family's insignia.

536.name: Adventurer Cpn.

This coupon is distributed to promising
recruits to get them started.

537.name: Damselfly Worm
desc:
A parasitic worm that lives in
the stomachs of damselflies.

538.name: Magicked Skull
desc:
This skull is inhabited by
the cursed soul of its former owner.

539.name: Crab Apron
desc:
The soft abdominal shell of
a land crab.

540.name: Bloody Robe
desc:
Ragged and bloodied robes that
belonged to a ghost.

541.name: Dhalmel Saliva
desc:
A cup of dhalmel saliva,
known for its phenomenal stench.

542.name: Wild Rabbit Tail
desc:
Wild rabbit tails are believed to bring
good luck.

543.name: Rusty Key
desc:
This rusty iron key looks
extremely brittle.

544.name: Test Answers
desc:
These terribly blotched and smeared 
sheets of paper are answer sheets 
from a test given at Windurst's 
School of Magic.

545.name: Shelling Piece
desc:
A shell used by Tarutaru as currency
in olden times.

546.name: Starfall Tear
desc:
Dew that forms for a few hours
only on Starfall Hillock.

547.name: Tomb Waterskin
desc: An old tomb guard's waterskin.

548.name: Tenshodo Invite
desc:
A letter of invitation to the Tenshodo,
an underground trade syndicate.

549.name: Delkfutt Key
desc:
This cermet key has an unusually
complex shape.

550.name: Steam Clock
desc:
This precise Bastokan timekeeper runs
on steam power.

551.name: Bruised Starfruit
desc:
A star tree fruit used in
the construction of a Cardian.
It looks damaged.

552.name: Hiwon's Hair
desc: A lock of Hiwon-Biwon's golden hair.

553.name: Dangruf Stone
desc:
Legend says that this precious red
stone is the coagulated blood of
a great Galkan warrior.

554.name: Gold Orcmask
desc:
A golden mask worn by Orcish royalty.
Due to its odd shape, only Orcs can
wear it.

555.name: Tower Petition
desc:
A petition protesting the plans
to demolish the clock tower in Jeuno.

556.name: Divination Sphere
desc:
A polished crystal ball used
for divination.

557.name: Ahriman Lens
desc:
A giant crystal lens taken from
an Ahriman.

558.name: Tarut:The Fool
desc:
Tarutaru use these cards for
divination.
When upright, the Fool symbolizes
"freedom." When reversed, "escape."

559.name: Tarut:Death
desc:
Tarutaru use these cards for
divination.
When upright, Death symbolizes
"sorrow." When reversed, "release."

560.name: Zeruhn Soot
desc:
Soot taken from monsters in the
Zeruhn mines. It is highly flammable
and should be handled with care.

561.name: Tarut:The King
desc:
Tarutaru use these cards for
divination.
When upright, the King symbolizes
"leadership." When reversed, "distrust."

562.name: Tarut:The Hermit
desc:
Tarutaru use these cards for
divination.
When upright, the Hermit symbolizes
"wisdom." When reversed, "isolation."

563.name: Glocolite
desc:
This bumpy, precious stone shines
dimly.

564.name: Fingernail Sack
desc:
This grimy burlap sack contains
a fingernail collection.
Used for making Goblin rot-tea.

565.name: Teeth Sack
desc:
This filthy burlap sack contains
rotting teeth.
Goblins believe that rotting teeth
bring good luck to bad people.

566.name: Goblin Cup
desc:
Goblins use these iron cups for
drinking their rot-tea.

567.name: Well Water
desc:
A waterskin filled with water drawn
from a well in San d'Oria.

568.name: Goblin Die
desc:
A die used in the Goblin game
"Mithra Tails." The sides are uneven.
Goblins don't like to take chances.

569.name: Gusgen Clay
desc:
This clay can be found in one corner
of the Gusgen Mines.

570.name: Clay Tablet
desc:
This clay tablet has had letters
pressed into it with a stone stylus.

571.name: Selbina Clay
desc:
This clay is taken from the outskirts
of Selbina.

This teardrop-shaped precious stone

577.name: Brass Key

This silver button is engraved with

desc:
This bronze box sat on the ocean floor

This black stone is said to have fallen

This round stone is the perfect size

This paper appears to be a list of
items consumed at a tavern.
Smeared mud conceals part of the list.

A card sent to celebrate something.
It shows a great deal of wear and tear.

587.name: Damp Envelope
desc:
An envelope sealed with wax.
It is damp and somewhat warped.

desc:
This how-to art book for young people
is written in the Windurstian script.
Features works by famous artists
such as Pell-Mell and Pisoso.

desc:
Koru-Moru wrote this in his youth.
Consists of several hundred pages on
the art of alchemy.

590.name: Sailor's Cap
desc:
This black cap is awarded to sailors
after many years of faithful duty.
Owning one is every youth's dream.

591.name: Ripped Cap
desc:
This black cap is slightly ripped and
falling apart at the seams.
It closely resembles the coveted
"sailor's cap."

592.name: Supplies Order

This paper appears to be an order for
a clump of batagreens.

A parcel addressed to
Regine's Magicmart.

A parcel addressed to the
North Auction House in San d'Oria.

desc:
A parcel addressed to the
Rusty Anchor Pub.

This is gravel collected from the
mines around Bastok. Mixed in with
the gravel are shiny bits of ore.

598.name: Sharp Stone

A rough-hewn stone with sharp edges.
The ore in the rock glitters.

This mythril sand is obtained by
refining gravel from the mines.
The purity is too low for it to have
any market value.
